The interval-filling lemma is proved with full quantifiers and closure endpoints. Exact finite rationals verify five exceptional norms and trial-division primality verifies 73 split-prime witnesses. value.rationale: The cubic reciprocal exponent is the smallest positive integer exponent with a bounded Gaussian Euler product. An exact no-gap topological classification there is a motivated structural boundary, using the inert/split/ramified prime decomposition in an essential way. The theorem is an exact full-range result, not an arbitrary bounded census or merely another numerical constant; it does not claim a parameter-uniform theorem.
